name: VitalsTrend-MCP
description: NEWS2 trajectory computation, subtle deterioration detection, and watch subscription generation

tools.name: compute_news2_trajectory
tools.description: Compute NEWS2 score at each timepoint using Royal College of Physicians scoring tables and analyze trajectory including rate-of-change and acceleration. Deterministic — no LLM.

time_window_hours.description: Time window in hours for trajectory analysis

tools.name: detect_subtle_deterioration
tools.description: LLM-powered interpretation of NEWS2 trajectory acceleration vs population archetype. Identifies emerging deterioration not visible from individual threshold checks.

tools.name: generate_watch_subscriptions
tools.description: Generate FHIR Subscription resources for monitoring based on open questions and dissonance conflicts. Deterministic — no LLM.

open_questions.description: FHIR Task resources representing open clinical questions
